adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-256 in the diff: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;` - When externalCalendarId is falsy (missing), the code falls back to searching destinationCalendar for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId`. But externalCalendarId is undefined/null at this point, so this search will never find a match (no calendar has externalId === undefined). This is clearly a logic bug - the fallback should use a different criterion (like credentialId) to find the right calendar, not search for the same missing value. The same bug appears at line 314-316 in deleteEvent.
